gaps.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.
gaps.note: Nondegeneracy relative to the bilinear form is not defined or linked; the reader has only met inner products, not indefinite forms, and does not know why it is needed (e.g. for U and U^perp to give a projection).
The form gives |T cap S|-1, which is zero only when |T cap S|=1; for disjoint triples it is -1 and for overlap 2 it is 1, so orthogonality of all distinct triples does not follow from what is shown.

gaps.quote: a label containing $t_T$ may grow to $t_S^\perp$
gaps.note: Labels are subspaces of the h^3-dimensional space F, but t_S^perp is introduced as a complement in Q^h; why the label can grow this way and why it adds h-2 dimensions is not explained.
The page never says there are W sinks (or how many gates and edges), so the count of sink dimensions as WD and the telescoping to this total cannot be checked.
